# 2FACode.co

> A free, secure, privacy-focused two-factor authentication (TOTP) code generator that works entirely in your browser. No data is ever sent to a server.

## What this site does

- Generates TOTP (Time-based One-Time Password) codes from Base32 secret keys, following RFC 6238 / RFC 4226.
- All computation happens client-side using the Web Crypto API — no secrets ever leave the browser.
- Accounts and secret keys are saved in localStorage, optionally PIN-encrypted using AES-GCM with PBKDF2 key derivation.
- Codes refresh automatically every 30 seconds in sync with the TOTP window.

## Pages

- `https://2facode.co/` — Main generator. Users paste their secret keys and get live TOTP codes.
- `https://2facode.co/about` — Explains the security model, how TOTP works, and privacy guarantees.

## Key features

- Works offline after first load (no external network requests).
- PIN-encrypted local storage (optional) — AES-GCM, PBKDF2, 200 000 iterations.
- 7-day account expiry with export/import backup support.
- Dark mode, mobile responsive.
- No tracking, no analytics, no cookies.

## Technical stack

- PHP (server-side rendering, headers only — no server-side logic for crypto).
- Vanilla JS (Web Crypto API for TOTP and PIN encryption).
- No frameworks, no CDN dependencies.
